title: Symbolic spectrum of characteristic time scales
description: A symbolic catalogue of proposed characteristic-time ranges across several domains. The intervals are illustrative scale labels, not measurements of one shared process or evidence for a universal relaxation law.
definitions: tau is a positive characteristic time expressed in seconds.
The listed domain labels identify illustrative orders of magnitude only.
Overlapping intervals are permitted and do not imply shared mechanisms.

quantities.name: tau_planck_scale
quantities.reference: Approximate Planck-time order of magnitude; contextual scale label

assumptions: All time intervals are illustrative symbolic labels and are not an empirical survey or a common fitted dataset.
The Planck-scale entry denotes an order-of-magnitude reference, not a measured relaxation time.
The condensation entry is a numerical analogy only; no phase transition, condensation mechanism or physical equivalence is asserted.
mechanism: This node groups proposed time-scale labels and a zeta-value analogy as a symbolic comparison. It specifies no dynamics connecting the domains.
confusion_guard: SYM entries are not established cross-domain constants. Overlapping ranges, the Planck-scale label, and zeta(3.3) do not demonstrate a shared process or condensation law.
